topic: Campaign configuration and system bug fixes
summary_markdown:
A campaign issue was reported where a client noticed that customizations were missing on both the production and staging environments. Specifically, the loop duration functionality (which previously supported weeks/months) and cluster filtering signs were broken. The issue was confirmed to have occurred after recent development work.

The system fix was implemented across two locations to prevent future analytics failures. One participant noted that the breakage likely happened yesterday evening while implementing a feature, affecting the database slightly. Another participant clarified that the current environment is an LTS (Long-term support) version of the software.
decisions: The broken loop duration and cluster filtering signs were fixed on production and staging environments.
